description: Golden set for IdeaForge output quality. Each case states what a good answer must contain, not what it must say word for word — the model is free to phrase things its own way, and the checks assert substance.

cases.idea: An app that reminds students to drink water
cases.why: A saturated, low-severity space. The copilot must be willing to say so rather than flatter the user.

cases.idea: A hyperlocal flash-flood alert tool fusing soil-moisture data with short-term rainfall forecasts
cases.why: A genuine life-safety problem in an underserved niche. Should score high on severity and be recognised as technically demanding.

cases.idea: A tool that analyses satellite imagery to detect illegal deforestation in the Amazon
cases.why: Guards against the failure where every idea gets the same generic web stack. A geospatial problem must produce geospatial tooling.

cases.idea: A campus tool that matches students to research labs by interest
cases.why: A space with real incumbents. Research must cite real sources and name existing solutions rather than inventing them.
